title: Freestanding Toilet Tissue Stand 26-Inch Solid Brass European Style | Pink | Allied Brass
short_title: Freestanding Toilet Tissue Stand 26-Inch | Allied Brass, Pink
description:
Add convenient, no-drill paper storage with this freestanding toilet tissue stand crafted from solid brass and designed for quick roll changes in Pink, which brings playful, modern energy to bathroom design, offering a fresh take on hardware that celebrates individuality. The European style hook makes changing the roll quick and easy—ideal when wall space is limited.

Highlights:
- Pink transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Heavy base helps prevent tipping for steadier placement
- Crafted from solid brass for enduring strength
- Available in a wide variety of designer finish options

Specs:
- Category: Freestanding toilet tissue stands
- Material: Brass
- Overall size: 26-Inch H x 6.75-Inch L x 5.5-Inch W
- Weight: 4.8 lb
- Assembly required: Yes
- Included: Toilet tissue stand
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
- Assembled in the USA

A smart choice for traditional bathroom hardware and classic bath accessories that coordinate with heritage bathroom fixtures.
